additional_info.body:
Hello Nadeem,
Thank you for the feedback.
It seems OCPP is not working still:
I have 2 suggestions before we proceed to replace the component:
Put a piece of paper between the SIM card (plastic part not the magnetic) and the SIM Card tray, to close the distance between the reader and the magnetic band.
Use a new SIM card or test this SIM card with your phone for example.
If it works then it must be a router issue.
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
